The customer's request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred as a separate follow-up (a scoped, revocable machine-to-machine credential for Globex, to be reviewed with the security team) rather than silently implemented. Code settings (repo/auth.py agrees with facts): auth.token_ttl = AX-70256, auth.key_header = AX-73094.
